description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing environment variables within the lighttpd web server. It includes definitions for environment tables, their duplicates, and related operations such as setting, inserting, removing, and copying environment variables.

classes.name: liEnvironment
classes.description: Represents a collection of environment variables stored in a GHashTable.

classes.name: liEnvironmentDup
classes.description: Read-only duplicate of an environment, used for temporary or safe access to environment variables.

methods.name: li_environment_init
methods.description: Initializes an environment structure by creating a new hash table.

methods.name: li_environment_reset
methods.description: Clears all entries from the environment.

methods.name: li_environment_set
methods.description: Sets or overwrites an environment variable.

methods.name: li_environment_insert
methods.description: Inserts an environment variable if it does not already exist.

methods.name: li_environment_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: li_environment_make_dup
methods.description: Creates a read-only duplicate of an environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a variable from the duplicate environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup2cgi
methods.description: Calls a callback for each environment variable to convert it to CGI format, optionally replacing values with those from the duplicate environment.
